title: Aureline M5 tip-card component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the tip-card family binds inside the frozen M5 learning-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-learning-component-matrix.schema.json). A tip card names why a teaching tip appears, its cited source, and how it can be dismissed so teaching stays contextual, dismissible, and citation-backed. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-learning is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
